verdict.rationale: SolidJS explicitly advertises 'Universal: write custom renderers to use Solid anywhere' (solid-gh-6), directly matching the story, with corroborating first-party evidence of its DOM-based rendering being real and inspectable (solid-gh-5) and library extensibility (solid-gh-8). Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on example of a non-DOM custom renderer (e.g., native/canvas/terminal target) being built and used in practice, and no documentation link detailing the custom-renderer API.
